segments.text: Lead three consultants and two client analysts on a cost mandate for a family-owned automotive supplier.
Brauer cost programme: identified €18.4 million of annual cost across 4 plants and 1,400 employees; the owner signed €11.2 million, and margin recovered 2.6 percentage points the following year.
Served nine clients in four years, six of them family-owned industrial businesses.
Commercial due diligence over three weeks: showed the evidence supported 3.1 per cent growth, not the 6 per cent the fund wanted.
Since 2023, run Saturday money workshops for apprentices at the Berufsschule am Mainbogen in Offenbach; 31 apprentices so far.
Project Leader, Halderbach Partners, Frankfurt (since July 2026). I lead three consultants and two client analysts on my current mandate. Senior Consultant from October 2024 to June 2026.

In 2025, as a Senior Consultant at Halderbach Partners, I ran 38 interviews across four plants for the Brauer cost programme. We identified €18.4 million of annual cost; the owner signed €11.2 million.

I became Project Leader in July 2026, one review cycle early. On my current mandate I lead three consultants and two client analysts, and I still check every figure four times before it goes in a pack.
